eyebrow: Every process has three of these
Connect two commands, no file involved
code:
$ ps aux | grep nginx
root    989  nginx: master process
www-data 1423  nginx: worker process
www-data 1424  nginx: worker process
caption: The pipe sends ps aux's stdout straight into grep's stdin

eyebrow: Send output to a file instead of the screen
code:
$ echo "deploy started" > deploy.log
$ cat deploy.log
deploy started

$ echo "deploy finished" >> deploy.log
$ cat deploy.log
deploy started
deploy finished
caption: > overwrites the file; >> appends a new line instead

eyebrow: Keep errors separate, or merge them, or drop them
code:
$ ls /var/log/nginx /var/log/missing-dir 2> errors.log
/var/log/nginx:
access.log  error.log

$ ./deploy.sh > deploy.log 2>&1
$ curl -s https://status.northbridgeretail.com > /dev/null
caption: 2> isolates stderr, 2>&1 merges it with stdout, /dev/null discards it

subtitle: The tools you'll pipe into constantly to search and reshape output.
